data.title: 拉姆 · 更衣帷幔后的毒舌警诫
data.action: 双手抱胸斜倚在衣柜门前，粉色短发微遮独眼，居高临下地微扬下巴，嘴角挑着毒舌却不自觉脸颊泛着浅红。
data.location: 罗兹瓦尔宅邸女仆休息室，古典木衣柜前挂着换下的黑白女仆围裙
data.timeOfDay: 夜间女仆勤务交接完毕后
data.lighting: 墙面黄铜烛台摇曳的温热烛光，将少女单薄玲珑的身影投射在雕花木衣柜上
data.mood: 外冷内热的毒舌姐姐反差，严厉训诫中的一丝娇嗔
data.description: 罗兹瓦尔宅邸女仆休息室，古典木衣柜前挂着换下的黑白女仆围裙。双手抱胸斜倚在衣柜门前，粉色短发微遮独眼，居高临下地微扬下巴，嘴角挑着毒舌却不自觉脸颊泛着浅红。 她微微抬眸轻语——“巴鲁斯，竟然大摇大摆地擅自闯进拉姆的更衣时间……眼珠如果不想要的话，拉姆现在就替你挖出来。”
data.promptProse: Standing with arms crossed against an open wooden wardrobe door inside Roswaal's mansion at night, Ram wears a crimson-berry square-neck sheer corset nightdress laced beneath the bust with black cords. With her black-and-white maid apron hanging behind her and a sharp yet faintly blushing glare on her face, she is lit by flickering brass wall candlelight.
data.animaCaption: Leaning haughtily against an open wooden wardrobe door where her maid uniform hangs, she folds her arms in a crimson square-neck sheer corset nightdress with black underbust lacing and shoots down a proud, faintly blushing glare. Flickering brass wall candlelight warms the quiet maid quarters.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep crimson-berry square-neck sheer corset nightdress cinching her waist with black underbust lace-up cords and a scalloped hem.
